title: Independent audit: rank-two defect and dirty cleanup of three staged entries
body:
Independent mathematical audit of PR #4076 at `9744f9df268590295a9872b1952c695a678192b9`; exact canonical base `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`.

The three staged entries have a common, explicit **register-coefficient rank-two** defect before cleanup on both providers:

```
δ417 = (h608+h609)/2       δ565 = h600/2
δ610 = −h608−h609         δ602 = −h600
```

All other rows are unchanged. Inputs denote original arbitrary helper fields. All eight subsets compose without cross terms. Every subset realizes the required target update and returns all 91 arbitrary dirty private fields after its regenerated projected cleanup. The prefixes themselves differ. For D-dimensional fields the full defect rank is 2D; this does not imply a physical two-role saving.

This provides small reusable staging witnesses and new-source independent evidence beyond the existing binary ledger and retained interpreter replay. `algebra.py` executes no predecessor Python and works over the exact rational free-group algebra, with no native-operator commutation assumed. `PROOF.md` states the identity, soundness argument and cleanup boundary. A separate raw-word evaluator tests noncommuting 2×2 operators against the actual literal cleanup.

Validation:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/staged-entry-release-audit
```

Expected: `PASS_STAGED_ENTRY_RANK_TWO_DEFECT` (2 providers, 16 subsets, 723 full-state blocks, 28 rejections), `PASS_NONCOMMUTING_STAGING_ORACLE` and `PASS_STAGING_ALGEBRA_CONTROLS`, followed by registered-package success. All three registered commands pass; official 16-file committed-byte/source-history and export/check pass. All three commands pass normally and under `-O` in a read-only Git-free export with empty effective PATH; all 17 files retain bytes, modes and inodes. Local Python 3.12.14; hosted CI is separate.

Four exact source words are retained and checked by SHA256/Git blob. `PINS.json` records original PR paths/head; publication history authenticates the local freeze at `d39e1a8d3685e711e6a13658df3cfeda175bfc7f`. The pending predecessor is not an ancestor, and source-history preflight does not claim otherwise. No source or selected-frontier file changes.

Scope: finite exact word/composition audit, not formal-kernel verification. Hybrid subsets have no frame/owner admission. Native Gaussian phases, numerical precision, physical source/owner/tape costs, complete supplier/outer admission and the later #4085 receiver-sharing construction are separate. No new κ is claimed. TASK.json records the next useful compiler question and blockers. Final overlap refresh found #4085 but no duplicate defect factorization.

Credit Rohan Arun/#4076; Ross Richardson/#3605, dataisfire/#3734, ChaloupeMusic/Erwan Secousses/#3949, Dugongue/#3945; Sagar Thakrar/#3687, roger-sato/#3693, Arham Tahir and the retained source/compiler/cleanup lineage. Complete source notice retained. New factorization, implementation and checks by Tekalign (`tekuuu`) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No independent human acceptance is claimed.
